scenes.text: Claude built it in four phases, one prompt each. The editor keeps list prices fixed, updates totals live, and warns when a discount needs a manager.
But the useful part is what broke. Sign-in matched people by email, but the seed people had no emails. And Duplicate didn't say what gets copied, like the discount and notes.
PandaDoc Starter is nineteen dollars per seat per month, and Business is forty-nine. If you send a few quotes a week, you mostly need the price list, the approval rule, and an accept link.
